gold_review.explanation: The answer is the incident id ("INC-001"); the score is computed from sandbox state reached via inspect/edit/operate tool calls plus a final JSON root_cause report, so any text-only reply gets the same 0.3. Side note: that 0.3 is a do-nothing floor (safety 20 + efficiency 10 awarded when no actions are taken), but diagnosis/recovery/durability (70%) still require the real fix.
gold_review.evidence: src production_fire_drill/__init__.py:228-252 score(): safety=20 and efficiency=10 when plant.actions empty, diagnosis needs inspected logs+metrics; :31 id=f"INC-{index+1:03d}"; gold_raw.log incident_reward r1: [0.3]*5 = garbage 0.3
